system.description:
Lore: Fabled Relic Scroll (Consumable)

No one has ever found a good reason to use this scroll on purpose. That has never stopped anyone from keeping one around, just in case a reason arrives.

Read this scroll as an Action to summon the Tarrasque in an unoccupied space you can see within 1 Mile. It disappears when reduced to 0 HP, and is hostile to everything but itself - including you.

It has the following Powers:

  • Inscribed Casting: Read it as an Action to summon the Tarrasque in an unoccupied space you can see within 1 Mile. It is hostile to everything, obeys no one, and vanishes at 0 HP. The scroll is consumed.

Value: 500000g
system.source: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden (Vagabond conversion)
